rating_definitions.pass: The core complaint meaning and requested action are clear.
rating_definitions.partial: The core intent is understandable, but important wording is imperfect or omitted.
rating_definitions.fail: The output is unusable, materially changes or omits the intent, or fabricates meaning.

cases.review_reason: The date conflict is retained, but the early execution and investigation request are not fully explicit.
cases.myanmar_input: ကြိုတင်သတ်မှတ်ထားတဲ့ ငွေလွှဲရက်က မနက်ဖြန်ဖြစ်ပေမယ့် ဒီနေ့ပဲ ထွက်သွားပါတယ်။ ရက်စွဲကို စစ်ပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: The pre-set date for the money transfer is tomorrow, but it's today. Check the date.
cases.expected_english_intent: Investigate a scheduled transfer that executed one day early.

cases.review_reason: The output fabricates an announcement and changes the requested transfer-limit increase into a statement.
cases.myanmar_input: တစ်ရက်လျှင် ငွေလွှဲနိုင်သည့် limit ကို ၂ သိန်းမှ တိုးမြှင့်လိုပါသည်။ လုပ်ဆောင်ရမည့်အဆင့်များကို ပြောပြပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: The bank has also announced that it will increase the amount of money transferred to the bank by the end of the year to $200,000 per day.
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask how to increase the daily transfer limit from 200,000.

cases.review_reason: The incorrect transfer reference and correction request are both clear.
cases.myanmar_input: လက်ခံသူမှန်ပေမယ့် transfer reference က မှားနေတယ်။ မှတ်တမ်းကို ပြင်လို့ရမလား။
cases.generated_english_translation: The recipient is right, but the transfer reference is wrong. Can you correct the record?
cases.expected_english_intent: Request correction of an incorrect recipient transfer reference.

cases.review_reason: The merchant-ledger reconciliation request is changed into an unclear shopping-list request.
cases.myanmar_input: ဆိုင်မှာ QR နဲ့ ၃၅၀၀၀ ကျပ်ပေးပြီး အောင်မြင်တယ်လို့ပြပေမယ့် ဆိုင်ဘက်စာရင်းမှာ မပေါ်သေးပါ။ စာရင်းညှိပေးစေလိုပါတယ်။
cases.generated_english_translation: I gave them a QR and 35,000 in the store, and it was a success, but it's not on the shopping list yet. I want to list it.
cases.expected_english_intent: Reconcile a 35,000 kyat QR payment missing from the merchant ledger.

cases.review_reason: The output changes monthly dates into a 15-day interval and omits the correction request.
cases.myanmar_input: လစဉ် recurring remittance ကို ၁၅ ရက်နေ့တိုင်းပို့ဖို့ထားတာ ၁၆ ရက်နေ့မှ စတင်နေပါတယ်။ အချိန်ဇယားကို ပြင်ပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: We have a monthly recurring remittance to be sent every 15 days starting on the 16th.
cases.expected_english_intent: Correct a recurring remittance scheduled for the 15th that runs on the 16th.

cases.review_reason: The joint-account signature-record update requirements remain clear.
cases.myanmar_input: ပူးတွဲအကောင့်တွင် အခြားကိုင်ဆောင်သူ၏ လက်မှတ်ပုံစံကို အသစ်ပြောင်းရန် လိုအပ်ချက်များကို ရှင်းပြပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: Explain the requirements for changing the form of the other holder's signature on the partner account.
cases.expected_english_intent: Explain requirements to update a joint account holder's signature record.

cases.review_reason: Dormant savings-account reuse is clear, but the requested reactivation requirements are rendered vaguely.
cases.myanmar_input: အချိန်ကြာလို့ dormant ဖြစ်နေတဲ့ savings account ကို ပြန်သုံးချင်တယ်။ ဘာတွေယူလာရမလဲ။
cases.generated_english_translation: I want to reuse a savings account that's been dormant for a while. What do I get?
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask how to reactivate a dormant savings account.

cases.review_reason: The statement and interest investigation remain understandable, but missing posted interest is weakened.
cases.myanmar_input: ဤလ စုငွေအတိုးကို statement တွင် မတွေ့ရပါ။ အတိုးတွက်ချက်မှုနှင့် ထည့်သွင်းမည့်ရက်ကို စစ်ဆေးပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: The monthly interest rate is not shown in the statement. Please check the interest rate and the date of the interest payment.
cases.expected_english_intent: Investigate missing savings interest and its posting date.

cases.review_reason: Removing and adding a beneficiary online is accurately retained.
cases.myanmar_input: အကောင့် beneficiary စာရင်းထဲက အဟောင်းကိုဖယ်ပြီး အသစ်တစ်ခုထည့်ချင်ပါတယ်။ online မှာ လုပ်နိုင်ပါသလား။
cases.generated_english_translation: I want to remove the old one from the list of account beneficiaries and add a new one. Can I do it online?
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask whether account beneficiary maintenance can be completed online.

cases.review_reason: The account-title spelling correction is present, but the sentence is awkward and partly self-referential.
cases.myanmar_input: စာရွက်စာတမ်းတွင် အကောင့်ခေါင်းစဉ် စာလုံးပေါင်းမှားနေသဖြင့် မှန်ကန်သည့်ခေါင်းစဉ်သို့ ပြင်ဆင်ပေးရန် တောင်းဆိုပါသည်။
cases.generated_english_translation: The document asks for the correct title to be corrected because the account title is spelled incorrectly.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request correction of a spelling error in the account title.

cases.review_reason: Disabling the card's contactless setting and the missing app control are clear.
cases.myanmar_input: ကတ်ရဲ့ contactless setting ကို ပိတ်ချင်တယ်။ app ထဲမှာ ခလုတ်မတွေ့ဘူး။
cases.generated_english_translation: I want to turn off the contactless settings of the card. I can't find the button in the app.
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask for help disabling the card's contactless setting.

cases.review_reason: The retained ATM card and request to block it remain clear.
cases.myanmar_input: ATM စက်က ကတ်ကို ပြန်မထုတ်ပေးဘဲ သိမ်းထားသည်။ စက်တည်နေရာအချက်အလက်မဖော်ပြဘဲ ကတ်ကို ဘယ်လိုပိတ်ရမလဲ သိလိုပါတယ်။
cases.generated_english_translation: The ATM keeps the card without returning it, and I want to know how to close the card without giving the machine location information.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request guidance after an ATM retained the card, including how to block it.

cases.review_reason: Replacement-card tracking and arrival-date checking are accurately retained.
cases.myanmar_input: replacement card ပို့မယ့်အခြေအနေကို tracking ကြည့်လို့မရပါ။ ရောက်မည့်ရက်ကို စစ်ပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: You can't track the status of the replacement card. Check the arrival date.
cases.expected_english_intent: Check the delivery status and expected date of a replacement card.

cases.review_reason: The output changes an ATM limit complaint into a bank announcement and reverses the request.
cases.myanmar_input: ATM မှ တစ်နေ့ ၅ သိန်းထုတ်လိုသော်လည်း ၃ သိန်းတွင် ငြင်းပယ်နေပါသည်။ ကတ်ထုတ်ယူမှု limit ကို စစ်ဆေးပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: The bank has also announced that it will be withdrawing Rs 5 lakh per day from the ATM but will refuse Rs 3 lakh.
cases.expected_english_intent: Investigate an ATM withdrawal limit blocking amounts above 300,000.

cases.review_reason: The ATM deposit amounts, receipt discrepancy, and investigation request are clear.
cases.myanmar_input: cash deposit ATM ထဲကို ၈၀၀၀၀ ကျပ်ထည့်တာ receipt မှာ ၆၀၀၀၀ ပဲပြတယ်။ ကွာခြားချက်ကို စစ်ပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: I put 80,000 cash in the ATM, and I only showed 60,000 on the receipt. Check the difference.
cases.expected_english_intent: Investigate an ATM cash deposit receipt showing 60,000 instead of 80,000.

cases.review_reason: The unknown-device security alert and session-closing request are retained.
cases.myanmar_input: မသိသော device တစ်ခုမှ login ဝင်ထားကြောင်း security alert ရပါသည်။ session များပိတ်ပြီး စစ်ဆေးပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: Security alert is sent to you from an unknown device. Close the session and check.
cases.expected_english_intent: Respond to a security alert for a login from an unknown device.

cases.review_reason: The suspicious link and phishing concern remain, but the bank-like appearance is translated imprecisely.
cases.myanmar_input: ဘဏ်ပုံစံတူ link တစ်ခုရောက်လာလို့ မနှိပ်သေးဘူး။ phishing ဟုတ်မဟုတ် စစ်ပေးနိုင်မလား။
cases.generated_english_translation: I got a link that was a bank file and I haven't clicked yet. Can I check if it's phishing or not?
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask whether a suspicious bank-like link is a phishing attempt.

cases.review_reason: The output omits the security-protection request and does not clearly express the unexpected SIM-change warning.
cases.myanmar_input: SIM ပြောင်းရန် မတောင်းဆိုထားသော်လည်း OTP အသစ်ရရှိခဲ့သည်။ လုံခြုံရေးအတွက် အကောင့်ကို ခေတ္တကာကွယ်ပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: The new OTP was obtained without requiring a change of SIM.
cases.expected_english_intent: Protect the account after an unexpected SIM-change OTP.

cases.review_reason: The security freeze request and later reopening requirements remain understandable.
cases.myanmar_input: သံသယဖြစ်ဖွယ် လှုပ်ရှားမှုကြောင့် security freeze တင်ထားချင်ပါတယ်။ ပြန်ဖွင့်ရန် လိုအပ်ချက်ကိုလည်း ပြောပြပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: I want to keep the security freeze on suspicious activity and tell you the need to reopen it.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request a security freeze and instructions for later removal.

cases.review_reason: The unrecognized credit inquiry is retained, but the investigation and protection request are omitted.
cases.myanmar_input: မိမိမလျှောက်ထားသော credit inquiry တစ်ခု ပေါ်နေပါသည်။ အတုပြုလုပ်ထားခြင်းရှိမရှိ စုံစမ်းပြီး ကာကွယ်ပေးရန် တောင်းဆိုပါသည်။
cases.generated_english_translation: A credit inquiry is being launched that you have not applied for.
cases.expected_english_intent: Investigate and protect against an unrecognized credit inquiry.

cases.review_reason: Early settlement remains clear, but the output changes asking about extra fees into asserting there is no fee.
cases.myanmar_input: ချေးငွေကို သတ်မှတ်ရက်မတိုင်မီ အပြီးပေးချင်ပါတယ်။ early settlement quote နဲ့ အပိုကြေးရှိမရှိ ပေးပို့ပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: We want to pay off the loan by the deadline, with an early settlement quote and no extra charge.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request an early loan settlement quote including any extra fee.

cases.review_reason: The two payment amounts and principal issue remain, but the allocation relationship is phrased ambiguously.
cases.generated_english_translation: Explain why the principal was reduced from the final payment of 120,000 to 20,000.
cases.expected_english_intent: Explain why only 20,000 of a 120,000 loan payment reduced principal.

cases.review_reason: Full repayment and a missing release document remain, but collateral is mistranslated as insurance.
cases.myanmar_input: ချေးငွေအားလုံးပေးချေပြီးဖြစ်သော်လည်း အာမခံပစ္စည်း release စာရွက် မရသေးပါ။ ထုတ်ပေးမည့်အချိန်ကို အတည်ပြုပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: All loans have been paid, but the insurance release document has not yet been received. Confirm the date of issue.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request the collateral release document after full loan repayment.

cases.review_reason: The missing receipt and request to confirm receipt of loan documents are clear.
cases.myanmar_input: loan documents အားလုံးပို့ပြီးပြီဆိုတဲ့ receipt မရဘူး။ စာရွက်တွေ လက်ခံရရှိကြောင်း အတည်ပြုပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: You don't get a receipt that all loan documents have been sent. Confirm that the documents have been received.
cases.expected_english_intent: Confirm receipt of all submitted loan documents.

cases.review_reason: The output changes the amounts and states that conditions are known instead of requesting eligibility requirements.
cases.myanmar_input: လက်ရှိ credit line ကို ၁၅ သိန်းမှ ၂၀ သိန်းသို့ ပြောင်းလဲရန် အရည်အချင်းနှင့် စည်းကမ်းချက်များကို သိလိုပါသည်။
cases.generated_english_translation: The current credit line is 15 to 20 million and the conditions and qualifications are known.
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask about eligibility to increase a credit line from 1.5 million to 2 million.

cases.review_reason: Visual accessibility remains recognizable, but screen-reader support is mistranslated as vowel reading.
cases.myanmar_input: အမြင်အာရုံအခက်အခဲရှိသူများအတွက် စာလုံးကြီးနှင့် အသံဖတ် accessibility option ရှိပါသလား။
cases.generated_english_translation: Is there an option for people with visual impairments to read in bold and vowel?
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask about large-text and screen-reader accessibility options.

cases.review_reason: The weekend customer-service opening-hours question is clear.
cases.myanmar_input: စနေ၊ တနင်္ဂနွေ customer service ဖွင့်ချိန် ဘယ်နှနာရီလဲ။
cases.generated_english_translation: What time is customer service open on Saturday and Sunday?
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask for weekend customer service opening hours.

cases.review_reason: The request for the location and method of obtaining Myanmar-language service documents is retained.
cases.myanmar_input: ဝန်ဆောင်မှုဆိုင်ရာ စာရွက်များကို မြန်မာဘာသာဖြင့် ဖတ်ရှုနိုင်မည့် နေရာနှင့် ရယူနည်းကို ညွှန်ပြပေးပါ။
cases.generated_english_translation: Please indicate where and how to read the service documents in Myanmar.
cases.expected_english_intent: Ask where to obtain service documents in Myanmar language.

cases.review_reason: The output reverses receipt acknowledgment into accepting a letter and loses the inquiry context.
cases.myanmar_input: စာဖြင့်ပို့ထားတဲ့ မေးခွန်းကို လက်ခံပြီးကြောင်း reference မပါဘဲ အတည်ပြုချက်တစ်စောင်လိုပါတယ်။
cases.generated_english_translation: I need a confirmation that I have accepted the letter without reference.
cases.expected_english_intent: Request acknowledgment that a written inquiry was received, without a case reference.

cases.review_reason: Changing notification preference from email to app notifications is accurately retained.
cases.myanmar_input: အထွေထွေ အသိပေးချက်တွေကို email မဟုတ်ဘဲ app notification ဖြင့်သာ လက်ခံနိုင်ရန် preference ပြောင်းလိုပါသည်။
cases.generated_english_translation: The preference for receiving general notifications is changed to be via app notification rather than email.
cases.expected_english_intent: Change general notification preference from email to app notifications.
